name: Carcaboso (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carcaboso (a wreath on red and the letters SPQR on blue).
history: The flag of Carcaboso was approved by the Order of 8 July 1987 of the Consejería de la Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 14 July 1987, after the municipal council's approval on 28 August 1986.

features.role: Carcaboso arms — wreath and the letters SPQR
